# Known ECM stage 2 hits on numbers of 4609 to 32768 bits: GMP-ECM stage 1 residues of curves
# that found a factor in step 2.
#
# Source: ECM factors of repunit cofactors reported on Makoto Kamada's repunit pages
# (https://stdkmd.net/nrr/repunit/, the monthly change pages, which give B1 and sigma; page,
# n, contributor and date of each result given). The composite each factor was found in was
# rebuilt from Phi_n(10) and the factor list (Phin10.txt), checked against the reported digit
# counts and leading digits; sigmas without a prefix are parametrization 0 (GMP-ECM 6,
# Prime95). The residues were recomputed with GMP-ECM 7.0.6 from N, sigma and B1, and
# GMP-ECM 7.0.6's stage 2 (with its default B2, or 100 times it where the logged run evidently
# used a larger B2) found the factor in step 2 for each.
# Chosen to cover the CGBN sizes above 4608 bits, B1 from 1e4 to 11e6, parametrizations 0, 1
# and 3 and the Brent-Suyama polynomials GMP-ECM picks: 44 hits, 4625 to 31309 bits.
#
# Format (tab-separated): B2 ("default": GMP-ECM's default)  options  factor  source  resume line
# Used by tests/run_hits.py.
